'''Spin-and-Win machines''' were a type of [[gambling]] device. During [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], they could be found in the [[Holiday Towers Hotel and Casino|Holiday Towers]] casino in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]]. After [[Zorba Desilijic Tiure]], the casino's owner at the time, escaped the [[Sarlacc/Legends|Sarlacc]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], he promised one hundred slightly used Spin-and-Win machines to a group of [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] in exchange for a ride to the [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley spaceport]].
